info.title: DotNetOpenApiExtract.Cli
info.description: CLI tool that extracts OpenAPI specifications from compiled .NET assemblies via static reflection — no application startup required

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Extract an OpenAPI specification from a compiled .NET assembly without running the application

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the .NET assembly DLL (produced by dotnet build)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path [default: swagger.json]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or yaml [default: json]

options.name: --title
options.description: API title (default: assembly file name without extension)

options.name: --version
options.description: Document version [default: v1]

options.name: --description
options.description: API description written to the info block

options.name: --xml
options.description: XML documentation file path (default: auto-detected next to the DLL)

options.name: --naming-policy
options.description: JSON property naming policy: preserve, camelCase (default), snake_case_lower, snake_case_upper, kebab-case-lower, kebab-case-upper

options.name: --enum-as-string
options.description: Serialize enum values as strings instead of integers [default: False]

options.name: --openapi-version
options.description: OpenAPI specification version: 3.0, 3.1, or 3.2 [default: 3.0]

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: Path prefix to exclude from the generated spec (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to a specific source file (e.g. entry point). Reserved for future use.

options.name: --source-root
options.description: Override the auto-detected source root directory (the folder containing .csproj). Use when the project layout does not follow the standard bin/ output convention.

options.name: --contact-name
options.description: Name of the contact person or organisation (written to info.contact.name)

options.name: --contact-email
options.description: Email address of the API contact (written to info.contact.email)

options.name: --contact-url
options.description: URL of the contact information page — must be an absolute URI (info.contact.url)

options.name: --license-name
options.description: SPDX license name, e.g. MIT or Apache-2.0 (written to info.license.name)

options.name: --license-url
options.description: URL pointing to the full license text — must be an absolute URI (info.license.url)

options.name: --terms-of-service
options.description: URL to the Terms of Service for the API — must be an absolute URI (info.termsOfService)

options.name: --server
options.description: Server base URL to include in the servers array (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --path-base-emission
options.description: How to emit the path base detected via app.UsePathBase(): 'prefix' (default) prepends to every path, 'servers' adds a relative servers[] entry [default: prefix]
